reason: Although the change is framed as DDL work, it modifies core transaction code in `pkg/kv/txn.go` and `pkg/sessiontxn/isolation/repeatable_read.go` to couple pessimistic locking, global ID allocation, and DDL job insertion in one transaction. That creates real risk in session/transaction behavior and KV consistency, with potential blast radius beyond the DDL call site, so it merits a focused Blocker/High review.
